create_esm_tokenizer: create an EsmTokenizer instance from a vocab file for protein sequence tokenization
build_inputs_with_special_tokens: build inputs with special tokens by wrapping token IDs with CLS and EOS tokens for ESM model
get_special_tokens_mask: get a special tokens mask marking CLS and EOS positions in tokenized ESM sequences
save_esm_vocabulary: save the ESM tokenizer vocabulary to a directory as a newline-separated text file
convert_esm_token_to_id: convert an ESM protein token string to its integer ID using the tokenizer vocabulary
